Aftershock Reveals Set Times for 2026 Edition, Oct. 1-4 in Sacramento

My Chemical Romance, Tool, Limp Bizkit, Pierce the Veil headline massive four-day festival

By Adrian Garro | August 18, 2026 | 0 Reply
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 9:16
Instaread

The Aftershock Festival returns in 2026 to Discovery Park in Sacramento, Calif., from Oct. 1-4 for another installment of Northern California’s biggest hard-rock, punk and metal festival.

Spanning four days and 135+ live acts — a mix of legacy bands, up-and-coming acts and fan favorites — it’s another huge lineup for the festival.

Set times have now been announced for the fest, with enough lead time to give ticketholders plenty of time to plan accordingly.

Rock Cellar has always made a philanthropic effort to support important causes and create a means to assist the Get Together Foundation in its work toward making the world a better place. Rock Cellar Productions sponsors their annual charity concert events featuring various musical themes and often including a variety of celebrity supporters.

The Get Together Foundation is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization located in Chatsworth (Los Angeles), California, founded by Rock Cellar publisher Kevin Wachs (and his wife Mare) as a 100% volunteer-based family foundation. Committed to action since 2001, GTF’s programs provide direct and immediate services – food, shelter, supplies, education, support – to children and families in need, crisis relief, and more. Please visit www.GetTogetherFoundation.org for more information.

Joni Mitchell At Newport [CD]

Artist: Joni Mitchell

$14.98

Joni Mitchell stunned the Newport Folk Festival audience last summer when she gave a surprise performance – her first in 20 years – delivering a heartfelt set filled with some of her greatest songs. Mitchell’s triumphant return to the stage on July 24, 2022, will be featured on a new live album from Rhino, AT NEWPORT, available on July 28, 2023 on CD and 2-LP black vinyl. Produced by close collaborator Brandi Carlile, along with Mitchell, the music will also be released the same day on digital and streaming services and Dolby Atmos.
